name: postgres-syntax
source: DO $$ BEGIN RAISE NOTICE 'never execute'; END $$;

name: finite-quote-storage
source: DECLARE @name sysname=QUOTENAME(@input); DECLARE @q nvarchar(max)=N'SELECT * FROM '+@name; EXEC(@q);

name: context-switch
source: DECLARE @q nvarchar(max)=N'SELECT 1'; EXECUTE AS USER='fixture'; EXEC(@q);
